description:
Experiment. mimalloc behind a cargo feature on fz-runtime, enabled only for the per-arm runtime staticlib (cargo rustc -p fz-runtime --crate-type staticlib) linked via FZ_AOT_RUNTIME_STATICLIB. fz2 links fz-runtime as an rlib without the feature and keeps the system allocator (Optimize's counting #[global_allocator] untouched); enabling it in fz2 fails at link time. Decides whether fz-9x7.12 needs fz code. Rules in cycles and page reclaims.

Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/Pqqu5yTcQdBbkGsZyZiykb (GC memory plan v3, approved by the user 2026-11-17).
title: Measure mimalloc as the global allocator for compiled programs against the system allocator (experiment)
